تستأهلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْهِلُوا (tastaʔhilū) /tas.taʔ.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# تُسْتَأْهَلُوا (tustaʔhalū) /tus.taʔ.ha.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
